covenants.quote: 7.1 The Borrower shall ensure that the Debt Service Coverage Ratio shall not be less than 1.35 times, tested quarterly on a trailing twelve month basis.
7.2 Total Debt to EBITDA shall not be more than 3.50 times on each test date.
7.3 The Interest Coverage Ratio shall at no time be lower than 2.25 times.
7.4 The Borrower shall maintain a Tangible Net Worth of not less than INR 600 Crores at all times.
8.1 The Borrower shall not create any lien, charge or encumbrance over its assets without the prior written consent of the Lender.
8.2 The Borrower shall keep its plant and stocks insured against all risks and shall maintain the insurance policies in force throughout the tenor.
